name: ChatRAG
author: guna

sections.description:
Add ChatRAG AI agents to your WordPress site using a simple Agent ID.

External Services

This plugin connects to the ChatRAG service to provide AI chatbot functionality on your website.

When active, the plugin will load a JavaScript file from https://chatrag.co/embed.min.js which communicates with the ChatRAG AI service.

The plugin sends your Agent ID to identify which AI agent to load. User interactions with the chatbot are processed through ChatRAG’s servers.

This service is provided by ChatRAG. Please review their:
– Terms of Service: https://chatrag.co/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://chatrag.co/privacy

Privacy

This plugin embeds a script from chatrag.co. Please review ChatRAG’s privacy policy for information on data handling.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chatrag directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > ChatRAG and enter your Agent ID from your ChatRAG dashboard
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Agent ID?

Log into your ChatRAG account at https://chatrag.co, select your agent and navigate to agent setting, and copy the Agent ID.
